# Refinery29

> > Refinery29 is a global lifestyle platform empowering young people through inclusive coverage of fashion, beauty, work, wellness, and cultural identity with a focus on underrepresented voices.

Refinery29 serves as a digital-first lifestyle destination featuring curated editorial content, product recommendations, and community-driven storytelling across fashion, beauty, entertainment, and social justice topics. The platform maintains dedicated channels celebrating Black culture (Unbothered), Latine communities (Somos), and Asian American representation, alongside core lifestyle verticals like Money Diaries and horoscope predictions.

## Key Topics

## Fashion & Style

- [Fashion: What To Wear, Trends, Styling Tips - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/fashion): Fashion hub: Designer trends, styling tips, shopping guides & red carpet looks from R29 editors.
- [Fitted: Everything Fashion at Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/fitted): Fitted: Fashion hub featuring runway trends, street style & seasonal shopping from editors & influencers.
- [Beauty: Skincare Tips, Hair & Makeup Trends - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/beauty): Beauty section: Skincare hacks, hair & makeup trends, product reviews & affordable beauty recommendations.
- [Beauty Studio - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/beauty-studio): Beauty Studio: Curated beauty guides, product reviews & makeup/skincare inspiration from editors & experts.
- [Shop The Best Beauty, Fashion & Homeware - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/shopping): Shopping hub with curated beauty, fashion & homeware picks from R29 editors across brands like Skims.

## Culture & Identity

- [Unbothered: Celebrating Black Voices & Folx - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/unbothered): Unbothered platform celebrating Black culture, strength & power with elevated voices & commentary.
- [Refinery29 Somos: Communities Of Latines](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/latine-somos): Somos platform exploring Latine identity, culture & community stories across lifestyle & social justice.
- [Not Your Token Asian 2024: Stories Honoring AAPI Month](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/aapi-heritage-month): AAPI Month feature celebrating Asian American stories, beauty, representation & cultural identity with creators.

## Money & Career

- [Money Diaries - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/money-diary): Money Diaries: Weekly spending stories revealing personal finance habits & salary transparency across regions.
- [Work & Money: Financial Advice & Career Tips - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/work-and-money): Work & Money section: Career tips, financial advice, budgeting & salary stories for professional growth.

## Wellness & Lifestyle

- [Wellness Trends, Sex & Relationships - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/health): Wellness hub covering health trends, relationships, mental health & lifestyle products for holistic living.
- [My Period: Getting Personal About Periods](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/my-period): My Period: Platform discussing menstrual equity, period education & women's health with celebrity voices.
- [Lifestyle: Interiors, Weddings, Travel & Recipes - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/living): Living section: Home interiors, travel, weddings, food & personal essays celebrating daily life experiences.
- [Horoscopes & Zodiac Star Sign Predictions - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/horoscope): Daily & weekly horoscopes by astrologers Lisa Stardust & Dossé-Via covering zodiac predictions & transits.

## Entertainment & News

- [Entertainment: Film & TV Releases, Celebrity News - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/entertainment): Entertainment section: TV, film, music & pop culture coverage with celebrity news & award show analysis.
- [US News & Current Events - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/us-news): US news coverage highlighting current events affecting underrepresented communities & social justice issues.
- [News & Politics - Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/politics): Politics & news section: Social justice, healthcare, immigration & reproductive rights coverage & analysis.

## International Editions

- [Refinery29 Australia | See, Feel, And Claim Your Power](https://www.refinery29.com/en-au): Refinery29 Australia: Localized content on fashion, beauty, wellness & culture for Australian audiences.
- [Refinery29 France](https://www.refinery29.com/fr-fr): Refinery29 France: French edition featuring inclusive lifestyle, beauty, fashion & cultural content.

## Core Hub

- [Refinery29](https://www.refinery29.com/en-us): Refinery29 homepage: Global lifestyle platform for young people covering fashion, beauty, work, relationships & identity.
